dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, it's your turn. Please give your main arguments.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪts jʊr ˈtɜːrn. ˈpliːz ˈɡɪv jʊr ˈmeɪn ˈɑːrɡjəmənts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. I have three arguments. Firstly, free university gives everyone the same opportunity.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. aɪ ˈhæv ˈθriː ˈɑːrɡjəmənts. ˈfɜːrstli, ˈfriː ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈɡɪvz ˈɛvriwʌn ðə ˈseɪm ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Secondly, our country needs more skilled workers, and universities can train them.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɛkəndli, aʊr ˈkʌntri ˈniːdz ˈmɔːr ˈskɪld ˈwɜːrkərz, ənd ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz kən ˈtreɪn ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But have you considered the cost?
dialogue.reading: bʌt hæv juː kənˈsɪdərd ðə ˈkɔːst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. That's my last argument. Lastly, graduates earn more, so the country gets its money back later.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæv. ðæts maɪ ˈlæst ˈɑːrɡjəmənt. ˈlæstli, ˈɡrædʒueɪts ˈɜːrn ˈmɔːr, soʊ ðə ˈkʌntri ˈɡɛts ɪts ˈmʌni ˈbæk ˈleɪtər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thank you, Nam. Ploy, what are your arguments?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈnɑːm. ˈplɔɪ, ˈwʌt ər jʊr ˈɑːrɡjəmənts?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Firstly, please consider the cost. Free university for everyone is very expensive. Secondly, rich families don't need help.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrstli, ˈpliːz kənˈsɪdər ðə ˈkɔːst. ˈfriː ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti fər ˈɛvriwʌn ɪz ˈvɛri ɪkˈspɛnsɪv. ˈsɛkəndli, ˈrɪtʃ ˈfæməliz ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd ˈhɛlp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's partly true, but how do you decide who is rich?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈpɑːrtli ˈtruː, bʌt ˈhaʊ duː juː dɪˈsaɪd huː ɪz ˈrɪtʃ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a good question. Finally, we should consider the young people who don't go to university at all. Why should they pay for others?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd ˈkwɛstʃən. ˈfaɪnəli, wiː ʃʊd kənˈsɪdər ðə ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl huː ˈdoʊnt ˈɡoʊ tə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ət ˈɔːl. ˈwaɪ ʃʊd ðeɪ ˈpeɪ fər ˈʌðərz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You both made strong points! Let's consider all of them before we decide.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈboʊθ ˈmeɪd ˈstrɔːŋ ˈpɔɪnts! ˈlɛts kənˈsɪdər ˈɔːl əv ðɛm bɪˈfɔːr wiː dɪˈsaɪd.
